stories.title: Generate and serve RSS/Atom feed for blog at /feed.xml
stories.description: Implement RSS/Atom feed generation from blog posts, served at /feed.xml. This enables blog subscribers and news aggregators to follow new articles.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns status 200 with Content-Type: application/atom+xml header and valid Atom 1.0 XML body
Feed includes <entry> element for each published blog post with title, link (post URL), updated (publishDate), and content (full post markdown)
Feed.xml route handler calls generateAtomFeed(posts: BlogPost[]): string function exported from lib/rss.ts
technicalNotes: File to edit: lib/rss.ts (new file, export generateAtomFeed function that builds Atom XML ~100 lines)
File to edit: app/feed.xml/route.ts (new route handler, async GET() returns Response with XML body ~40 lines)
Test command: npm run build && curl -H 'Accept: application/atom+xml' http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | head -30
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 0 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Add Table of Contents component for blog posts with scroll-to-section navigation
stories.description: Create a sticky TOC component that auto-generates from h2/h3 headings in blog posts, allowing readers to jump to sections. Improves UX for longer-form content.
acceptanceCriteria: BlogTableOfContents component renders above article content, displays h2 and h3 headings in nested list structure with indentation
Each TOC link uses fragment identifier (#heading-id) matching markdown heading ID; clicking scrolls smoothly to section
Active heading is highlighted via useEffect hook monitoring scroll position using Intersection Observer; highlights persist as user scrolls

stories.title: Calculate and display estimated reading time on blog posts
stories.description: Add a '5 min read' label to blog post cards and article headers based on word count. Helps readers decide which articles to read.
acceptanceCriteria: BlogPostCard component displays 'X min read' text next to publish date using readingTime(content: string): number function
Blog post article header (app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx) displays reading time: 'Published March 14 · 5 min read'
readingTime() utility in lib/readingTime.ts calculates minutes using standard 200 words-per-minute average

stories.title: Implement blog post category/tag filtering and dedicated category pages
stories.description: Add category and tag system to blog posts with filter UI on /blog page. Users can discover related articles by category (e.g., 'Backpacking', 'Jobs', 'Guides') and visit dedicated pages at /blog/category/[slug].
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post type in lib/blog.ts includes category: string and tags: string[] fields; all blog posts updated with categories in frontmatter
Blog listing page (/blog) renders BlogCategoryFilter component with category buttons; selected category persists in URL as ?category=backpacking
Category pages generated at /blog/category/[slug] via generateStaticParams() returning all unique categories; each page displays only posts matching that category

stories.title: Create JB News & Updates widget for homepage pulling from curated RSS sources
stories.description: Build a homepage widget fetching latest news items from curated RSS feeds about Johor Bahru (tourism, events, local updates). Updates hourly via ISR. Drives homepage engagement and positions site as news authority.
acceptanceCriteria: JBNewsWidget Server Component in components/JBNewsWidget.tsx fetches RSS feeds via lib/rssParser.ts and renders <ul> with 5 news items (headline, source, pubDate, 60-char preview)
Homepage /app/page.tsx imports and renders <JBNewsWidget /> component with revalidateTag('jb-news'); ISR revalidate: 3600 seconds
Curated feed URLs stored in config/rss-feeds.ts array; rssParser handles fetch timeouts and returns empty array gracefully; widget displays 'Unable to fetch news' fallback
